WITH virtualInventoryDetailHis AS ( select max(vidh.date), vid.sku_id, vid.warehouse_id, vid.virtual_warehouse_id, sum(vidh.wait_qty * vidh.inventory_age_days) as backInventoryAgeQty, sum(vidh.qty * vidh.inventory_age_days) as inventoryAgeQty from virtual_inventory_detail_his vidh left join virtual_inventory_detail vid on vidh.virtual_inventory_detail_id = vid.id and vid.is_deleted = false where vidh.is_deleted = false and vidh.date = #{dto.date} group by vid.sku_id,vid.warehouse_id,vid.virtual_warehouse_id ),VirtualInventoryHis AS ( SELECT max(vih.date), vi.sku_id, vi.warehouse_id, vi.virtual_warehouse_id, SUM(vih.qty) AS virtualQty, SUM(CASE WHEN vi.dict_inventory_status = 'usable' THEN vih.qty ELSE 0 END) AS virtualUsableQty, SUM(CASE WHEN vi.dict_inventory_status = 'frozen' THEN vih.qty ELSE 0 END) AS virtualFrozenQty FROM virtual_inventory_his vih left join virtual_inventory vi on vih.virtual_inventory_id = vi.id and vi.is_deleted = false WHERE vih.is_deleted = false and vih.date = #{dto.date} GROUP BY vi.sku_id, vi.warehouse_id, vi.virtual_warehouse_id ) select vidh.date as date, vidh.sku_id as skuId, pd.sku_no as skuNo, pd.name as productName, vidh.warehouse_id as warehouseId, wh."name" as warehouseName, vidh.virtual_warehouse_id as virtualWarehouseId, vw.code as virtualWarehouseCode, vw.name as virtualWarehouseName, vih.virtualQty, vih.virtualUsableQty, vih.virtualFrozenQty, case when vih.virtualQty = 0 then 0 else vidh.inventoryAgeQty / vih.virtualQty end as avgInventoryAge, case when vih.virtualQty = 0 then 0 else vidh.backInventoryAgeQty / vih.virtualQty end as backAvgInventoryAge, from virtualInventoryDetailHis vidh left join VirtualInventoryHis vih on vidh.sku_id = vih.sku_id and vidh.warehouse_id = vih.warehouse_id and vidh.virtual_warehouse_id = vih.virtual_warehouse_id left join product_detail pd on vidh.sku_id = pd.id and pd.is_deleted = false left join warehouse wh on vidh.warehouse_id = wh.id and wh.is_deleted = false left join virtual_warehouse vw on vidh.virtual_warehouse_id = vw.id and vw.is_deleted = false
${params.sqlMap.default} order by
${item.field} ${item.sort}
vih.sku_id desc
